The Second Promotion Playoff or Torneo Reducido was played by the teams placed 2nd to 11th in the overall standings: [[Atlético Tucumán]] (2nd), who entered in the Semifinals, [[Club Atlético Belgrano|Belgrano]] (3rd), who entered in the Second Round, and in the first round entered [[San Martín de Tucumán|San Martín (T)]] (5th), [[Club Atletico Banfield|Banfield]] (6th), [[Almirante Brown de Isidro Casanova|Almirante Brown]] (7th), [[Instituto Atlético Central Córdoba|Instituto]] (8th), [[Club Atlético Douglas Haig|Douglas Haig]] (9th), [[Deportivo Morón]] (10th) and [[Atlético de Rafaela]] (11th), ([[Club Cipolletti|Cipolletti]] (4th) did not qualify because it was relegated). In the first round also participated the champion of [[Primera B Metropolitana]]: [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba (R)]], and [[Club Atlético Nueva Chicago|Nueva Chicago]] and [[San Martín de San Juan|San Martín (SJ)]], both winners of ''Zonales Noroeste y Sureste'' from ''Torneo del Interior''. Clubs with direct affiliation are all from [[Greater Buenos Aires]], with the exception of [[Club Atlético Newell's Old Boys|Newell's]], [[Club Atlético Rosario Central|Rosario Central]], [[Central Córdoba de Rosario|Central Córdoba]] and [[Argentino de Rosario]], all from [[Rosario]], and [[Unión de Santa Fe|Unión]] and [[Colón de Santa Fe|Colón]] from [[Santa Fe, Argentina|Santa Fe]]. ===Additional Playoff=== Since [[Central Córdoba de Santiago del Estero|Central Córdoba (SdE)]] and [[Club Atlético Tigre|Tigre]] finished with the same relegation co-efficient at the dividing line, a one-match playoff was held to determine who was relegated. Tigre lost so their got relegated to [[Primera B Metropolitana]], while Central Cordoba (SdE) remained in [[Primera B Nacional]]. {| align=center class="wikitable collapsed" style="font-size:95%; text-align: center; width: 70%;" |- !colspan=100% style="with: 100%;" align=center | Additional Playoff |- !width=30%|Home !width=15%|Result !width=30%|Away |-align=center |'''[[Central Córdoba de Santiago del Estero|Central Córdoba (SdE)]]''' |3 - 0 |[[Club Atlético Tigre|Tigre]] |} ===Relegation Playoff Matches=== Each tie was played on a home-and-away two-legged basis, but if the first match was won by the team of [[Primera B Nacional]] (who also played the first leg at home), there was no need to play the second. If instead, the team from the [[List of regional football leagues in Argentina|Regional leagues]] wins the first leg, the second leg must be played, leg that, if its won by the team of [[Primera B Nacional]], a third leg must be played, if the third leg finishes in a tie, the team from [[Primera B Nacional]] remains on it.
